title: A Space check-in no longer fires the practice-completed email: check-in nodes skip the practice.verified event

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-22: a member tapped the House of Fates tag and got 'Nice work! You just logged a practice'. ADR-1873

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. captureNode emitted practice.verified for every non-partner node, including Space check-ins. The 'Congrats on Practice' automation rule (email_actor, subject 'Nice work!') listens to that event, so a venue check-in sent a practice email. Check-in nodes now skip the event; the node_capture ledger row, Regulars, Resonance and the trust signal are unchanged. The rule itself is untouched and still fires for real practices.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/engagement/capture.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes(\"(node.kind as string) !== 'checkin'\")||!s.includes('LIVE-1271')){console.error('LIVE-1271: check-in still emits practice.verified');process.exit(1)}"
